title: conversations_taps: Add preference for machine readable output
description:
Add a preference for the conversations taps (both CLI and Wireshark)
for machine readable output. A preference probably makes a bit more
sense because people probably want to persist this. It's also specific
to one tap, so a tshark long option doesn't make as much sense, but
adding optional flags (as opposed to mandatory choices) becomes far
to difficult for the stat flags.

This preference is respected in the endpoints taps and Dialog as well.
    
Add a checkbox in the GUI to display the machine readable values,
set by default to the preference value.

Fix #18321

notes.body: Need to actually implement the Wireshark part. A downside of a pref is it makes it a bit harder to have different values for different open dialogs (though not impossible), but it seems hard to make it work on tshark otherwise.

Are there any other places where an option for machine-readable output would be useful? "Ideal for humans to read" and "ideal for a program to read" don't always match up.

Pretty much all the command line taps by default produce textual tables that are ideal for humans to read, but it can be useful to provide results more natural for programs to read. #10759 tracks some of that. The CLI taps that use the "stats_tree" interface were easy to make able to output several standard formats, but others would be useful too.

It's actually easier for some of the "equivalent" GUI taps to produce machine-readable output than the command line taps.
